_comment: crew — GLOBAL web-Dock config (~/.config/cmux/dock.json), rendered by
`crew apply`. Browser controls only: the board and the usage dashboard
are workspace-agnostic, but a terminal control's relative cwd resolves
from the config base — $HOME for the global config — so the git/checks/
spec loops live in each repo's .cmux/dock.json, where cwd '.' means the
repo. A repo config replaces this one wholesale (precedence, not merge),
which is why the project template carries these two controls as well.
The board page is inert until crew-listen pushes the renderer into it;
crew-board adopts the seeded surface instead of creating its own.
__INTENT_PORT__ must match the intent server's pin (CREW_INTENT_PORT,
